p: And: Christ in healing the leprous with the touch of his hand, shows that he abhors no sinners that come unto him, be they ever so unclean.

And when Jesus was entered into: Christ by setting before them the example of the uncircumcised centurion and yet of an excellent faith, provokes the Jews to jealousy, and together forewarns them of their being cast off and the calling of the Gentiles.
sit down with Abraham: A metaphor taken of banqueters, for they that sit down together are fellows in the banquet.
outer darkness: Who are outside the kingdom: For in the kingdom is light, and outside the kingdom is darkness.
And when Jesus was come into: Christ, in healing many diseases, shows that he was sent by his Father, that in him only we should seek remedy in all our miseries.
all that were sick: Of all sorts.
other side: For Capernaum was situated upon the lake of Tiberias.
And a certain scribe came: The true disciples of Christ must prepare themselves for all kinds of miseries.
And another of his disciples said: When God requires our labour, we must cease all our duty to men.
And when he was entered into: Although Christ often seems to neglect his own, even in most extreme dangers, yet in due time he calms all tempests, and brings his own to the haven.
And when he was come to: Christ came to deliver men from the miserable enslavement of Satan: but the world would rather go without Christ, than the vilest and least of their conveniences.

a good way off from them: On a hill, as Mark and Luke witness: Now Gederah, as Josephus records, book seventeen chapter thirteen, lived after the order of the Greeks and therefore we must not be surprised if there were swine there.
depart out of their coasts: Where men live as swine, there Christ does not abide, but demons.
